deviations.what: c5/c11/c13/c14 S10 *Step 4 · what you are signing* / *Confirm & lock*: title 'Confirm & lock' / help 'These are the balances this close will record.'; the frame's title is 'What you are signing' / 'These are the balances August will be locked at.'

c5/c11/c13/c14 S10 *Step 4*: the declared-balances card is titled 'Declared balances' and lists only the money A/Cs (Cash A/c ₹0, Cash in hand ₹21,600, SBI Saving ₹1,14,600) in rows 4 px apart with the amount in a Flexible beside the name, so it sits mid-row (x≈200 of 390) rather than at the right edge; the frame has no card title, lists cash, bank and party balances in tall hairline-divided rows with amounts right-aligned, parties marked '₹1,44,000 Dr' / '₹1,70,000 Cr'
deviations.reason: [screen] spec violation, not an owner question: 07 §13 🔒 says the confirm & lock step 'shows the balance vector summary', and 02 §8 step 4 🔒 names the declared balances and the client-computed balance vector as two separate things. _stepLock (s10_month_close_screen.dart:708-740) renders only CloseView.declaredBalances, which close_source.dart builds from the cash and bank A/Cs alone, so the party balances the frame lists (Guru Nanak Cloth House ₹1,44,000 Dr, Tuglaq Yarn Company ₹1,70,000 Cr) — part of the vector being signed — are missing. The frame follows the spec here; the fix belongs to the close owner (screen + CloseView), with Dr/Cr allowed after the consumer wording in brackets (ADR 2026-10-10b §4). The mid-row amount is a separate [screen] layout defect (Flexible + RkFitText in _stepLock)
deviations.authority: 07 §13 🔒 (confirm & lock shows the balance vector summary); 02 §8 step 4 🔒 (declared balances and the balance vector hash); ADR 2026-10-10b §4; ADR 2026-10-05 §1
